title: Elite: Bind the Chain-Tithe Causeway: Warden Duel
description: Elite: Bind the Chain-Tithe Causeway: Warden Duel is a rebuilt Mythos Gates mission beat for Black-Iron Debt Descent through The Black-Iron Gate (Distortion Gate bound by contract clauses). One selected deity from Lucifer, Lilith, Asmodeus, Naamah enters; this beat spotlights Asmodeus as the reference silhouette while preserving player choice. The mission is the elite step at Chain-Tithe Causeway, using infernal court, bargain market, and chain causeway pacing so shrine, treasure, hazard, elite, and boss reads are route-specific as a finished Mythos Gates campaign beat. Appearance rule: The Infernal Dominion is the source culture behind later mortal myth echoes; terrain, relics, enemy silhouettes, and rewards must use black iron crowns, volcanic glass armor, contract parchment skin, chain mantles, ember fissures, horn hierarchies, bat/dragon wing shadows, clawed court gloves, blood wax seals, ash velvet, obsidian thrones, coin/debt motifs, execution architecture..
lore: Ascension canon route rewrite: Black-Iron Debt Descent is not a simple portal and not mortal apotheosis. It is a living Mythos Gate route where restored gods and goddesses answer Realm law under Hollow pressure. This mission advances Chain-Tithe Causeway and reveals: How repeated mistakes become chains. No armies, squads, or simultaneous party bodies enter standard combat; the route is balanced around one active deity versus many enemies.
terrain: Chain-Tithe Causeway configured as a elite space inside infernal court, bargain market, and chain causeway; source-culture appearance layer: black iron courts, volcanic glass aisles, ember chain channels, debtor seal floors, contract dais, obsidian throne shadows; cosmetic/relic silhouettes: Goetic chain-crown blades, volcanic glass debtor plates, blood-wax infernal ledger cores, chain-lien reversals
